params.label: Favorite Slots
params.description: Configure up to three favorite toggles for on-road buttons and steering-wheel bindings.

params.label: Advanced Lateral Tuning
params.description: Advanced steering control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.

params.label: Use Auto-Learned Delay
params.description: Automatically learn the full steering delay. The manual actuator delay is ignored while enabled.

params.label: Actuator Delay
params.description: Exact full delay between steering command and vehicle response.

params.label: Friction
params.description: Friction

params.label: Kp Factor
params.description: Kp Factor

params.label: Lateral Acceleration
params.description: Lateral Acceleration

params.label: Steer Ratio
params.description: Steer Ratio

params.label: Force Auto-Tune On
params.description: Force-enable openpilot's live auto-tuning for "Friction" and "Lateral Acceleration".

params.label: Force Auto-Tune Off
params.description: Force-disable openpilot's live auto-tuning for "Friction" and "Lateral Acceleration" and use the set value instead.

params.label: Force Torque Controller
params.description: Use torque-based steering control instead of angle-based control for smoother lane keeping, especially in curves.

params.label: Always On Lateral
params.description: openpilot's steering remains active even when the accelerator or brake pedals are pressed.

params.label: Pause on Brake Press Below
params.description: Pause "Always On Lateral" below the set speed while the brake pedal is pressed.

params.label: Lane Changes
params.description: Allow openpilot to change lanes.

params.label: Automatic Lane Changes
params.description: When the turn signal is on, openpilot will automatically change lanes. If a vehicle is detected in the blind spot, the lane change waits until it is clear. No steering-wheel nudge required!

params.label: Automatic Lane Changes Only When Engaged
params.description: Require a steering-wheel nudge for lane changes while using Always On Lateral without full engagement.

params.label: Lane Change Delay
params.description: Delay between turn signal activation and the start of an automatic lane change.

params.label: Minimum Lane Change Speed
params.description: Lowest speed at which openpilot will change lanes.

params.label: Minimum Lane Width
params.description: Prevent automatic lane changes into lanes narrower than the set width.

params.label: One Lane Change Per Signal
params.description: Limit automatic lane changes to one per turn-signal activation.

params.label: Lane Change Smoothing
params.description: Controls how smoothly openpilot commits to a lane change. 10 is stock behavior; lower values produce a gentler, more gradual maneuver. 1 stretches the maneuver to ~8 seconds.

params.label: Close Gap On Lane Change
params.description: Allows for a temporary shorter follow distance behind lead so that openpilot merges smoothly out of current lane, it will allow car to accelerate as it changes lanes.

params.label: Temporary Follow Distance
params.description: Follow distance to hold while changing lanes. Only applied when shorter than your normal gap.

params.label: Lateral Tuning
params.description: Miscellaneous steering control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.

params.label: Force Turn Desires Below Lane Change Speed
params.description: While driving below the minimum lane change speed with an active turn signal, instruct openpilot to turn left/right.

params.label: Use Route Desires for Turns
params.description: Allow an active navigation route to request low-speed turn desires.

params.label: Use Route Desires for Lane Positioning
params.description: Allow route lane bias only after steering torque confirms the requested direction. It never initiates a lane change by itself.

params.label: Neural Network Feedforward (NNFF)
params.description: Twilsonco's "Neural Network FeedForward" controller. Uses a trained neural network model to predict steering torque based on vehicle speed, roll, and past/future planned path data for smoother, model-based steering.

params.label: Neural Network Feedforward (NNFF) Lite
params.description: A lightweight version of Twilsonco's "Neural Network FeedForward" controller. Uses the "look-ahead" planned lateral jerk logic from the full model to help smoothen steering adjustments in curves, but does not use the full neural network for torque calculation.

params.label: Quality of Life
params.description: Steering control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.

params.label: Pause Steering Below
params.description: Pause steering below the set speed.

params.label: Turn Signal Only
params.description: Only pause steering when the turn signal is active.

params.label: Lateral Resume Delay
params.description: Delay before lateral control resumes after the turn signal is turned off. Only applies when the vehicle speed dropped below half the "Pause Steering Below" speed during the turn signal. Set to 0 to disable.

params.label: Enable V-ASM
params.description: Camera-based adjacent spot monitoring using the driver camera. Supplements factory blind spot monitoring.
params.disabled_reason: Configure window annotations first in Galaxy > V-Adj Spot Monitor

params.label: Confidence Threshold
params.description: Minimum vehicle-detection confidence (0.80-1.00, default 0.94). Higher values reduce false positives but may miss detections.

params.label: Smoothing Duration
params.description: Temporal smoothing duration (0.1-0.5 seconds, default 0.2). Higher values reduce flicker but add latency.

params.label: Advanced Longitudinal Tuning
params.description: Advanced acceleration and braking control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.

params.label: EV Tuning
params.description: Use acceleration profiles tuned for EVs. Defaults to the vehicle's detected powertrain type but can be overridden if the automatic choice doesn't match.

params.label: Truck Tuning
params.description: Use aggressive acceleration profiles tuned for trucks. Intended for heavy vehicles that need stronger throttle.

params.label: Trailer Load
params.description: Add trailer weight to vehicle mass for tow-aware gas, brake, and conservative lateral assist. Enter the loaded trailer weight in pounds.

params.label: Custom Accel Profile
params.description: Replace the built-in acceleration profile with your own per-speed max-acceleration values. Breakpoint speeds stay fixed, and the starting defaults mirror the currently selected acceleration profile plus EV or Truck tuning.

params.label: 0 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 0 mph breakpoint.

params.label: 11 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 11 mph breakpoint.

params.label: 22 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 22 mph breakpoint.

params.label: 34 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 34 mph breakpoint.

params.label: 45 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 45 mph breakpoint.

params.label: 56 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 56 mph breakpoint.

params.label: 89 mph
params.description: Max acceleration in m/s² at the fixed 89 mph breakpoint.

params.label: Actuator Delay
params.description: Actuator Delay

params.label: Maximum Acceleration
params.description: Limit the strongest acceleration openpilot can command.

params.label: Start Acceleration
params.description: Start Acceleration

params.label: Start Speed
params.description: Start Speed

params.label: Stop Acceleration
params.description: Stop Acceleration

params.label: Stopping Rate
params.description: Stopping Rate

params.label: Stop Speed
params.description: Stop Speed

params.label: Conditional Experimental Mode
params.description: Automatically switch to "Experimental Mode" when set conditions are met. Allows the model to handle challenging situations with smarter decision making.

params.label: Persist Experimental State
params.description: Keep your manual Conditional Experimental override through reboots until you manually clear it.

params.label: Below
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when driving below this speed without a lead to help openpilot handle low-speed situations more smoothly.

params.label: Below (With Lead)
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when driving below this speed with a lead.

params.label: Curve Detected Ahead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a curve is detected to allow the model to set an appropriate speed for the curve.

params.label: \"Detected\" Stop Lights/Signs
params.description:
Switch to "Experimental Mode" whenever the driving model "detects" a red light or stop sign.

Disclaimer: openpilot does not explicitly detect traffic lights or stop signs. In "Experimental Mode", openpilot makes end-to-end driving decisions from camera input, which means it may stop even when there's no clear reason!

params.label: Lead Detected Ahead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a slower or stopped vehicle is detected. Can make braking smoother and more reliable on some vehicles.

params.label: Open Road
params.description: Keep Experimental Mode active on an open road after reaching the set speed when no lead vehicle is detected. This can help the model anticipate braking sooner.

params.label: Slower Lead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a slower lead vehicle is detected ahead.

params.label: Stopped Lead
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when a stopped lead vehicle is detected ahead.

params.label: Predicted Stop In
params.description:
Switch to "Experimental Mode" when openpilot predicts a stop within the set time. This is usually triggered when the model "sees" a red light or stop sign ahead.

Disclaimer: openpilot does not explicitly detect traffic lights or stop signs. In "Experimental Mode", openpilot makes end-to-end driving decisions from camera input, which means it may stop even when there's no clear reason!

params.label: Turn Signal Below
params.description: Switch to "Experimental Mode" when using a turn signal below the set speed to allow the model to choose an appropriate speed for smoother left and right turns.

params.label: Status Widget
params.description: Show which condition triggered "Experimental Mode" on the driving screen.

params.label: Curve Speed Controller
params.description: Automatically slow down for upcoming curves using data learned from your driving style, adapting to curves as you would.

params.label: Status Widget
params.description: Show the "Curve Speed Controller" target speed on the driving screen.

params.label: Only Without Lead
params.description: Only use Curve Speed Controller when not following a lead vehicle.

params.label: Reset Curve Data
params.description: Clear learned Curve Speed Controller data and begin training again from the default lateral acceleration.
params.confirm_message: Reset all learned Curve Speed Controller data? Training will restart from the default value.

params.label: Driving Personalities
params.description: Customize the "Driving Personalities" to better match your driving style.

params.label: Traffic Mode
params.description: Customize the "Traffic Mode" personality profile. Designed for stop-and-go driving.

params.label: Aggressive
params.description: Customize the "Aggressive" personality profile. Designed for assertive driving with tighter gaps.

params.label: Standard
params.description: Customize the "Standard" personality profile. Designed for balanced driving with moderate gaps.

params.label: Relaxed
params.description: Customize the "Relaxed" personality profile. Designed for smoother, more comfortable driving with larger gaps.

params.label: Following Distance
params.description: The minimum following distance to the lead vehicle in "Traffic Mode". openpilot blends between this value and the "Relaxed" profile as speed increases. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

params.label: Acceleration Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot accelerates in "Traffic Mode". Increase for gentler starts; decrease for faster but more abrupt takeoffs.

params.label: Braking Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot brakes in "Traffic Mode". Increase for gentler stops; decrease for quicker but sharper braking.

params.label: Safety Gap Bias
params.description: How much extra space openpilot keeps from the vehicle ahead in "Traffic Mode". Increase for larger gaps and more cautious following; decrease for tighter gaps and closer following.

params.label: Slowdown Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot slows down in "Traffic Mode". Increase for more gradual deceleration; decrease for faster but sharper slowdowns.

params.label: Speed-Up Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot speeds up in "Traffic Mode". Increase for more gradual acceleration; decrease for quicker but more jolting acceleration.

params.label: Following Distance
params.description:
How many seconds openpilot follows behind lead vehicles when using the "Aggressive" profile. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

Default: 1.25 seconds.

params.label: High Speed Following Distance
params.description: Following distance for higher speeds in the "Aggressive" profile. openpilot smoothly blends from the base value to this value as speed rises.

params.label: Acceleration Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot accelerates with the "Aggressive" profile. Increase for gentler starts; decrease for faster but more abrupt takeoffs.

params.label: Braking Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot brakes with the "Aggressive" profile. Increase for gentler stops; decrease for quicker but sharper braking.

params.label: Safety Gap Bias
params.description: How much extra space openpilot keeps from the vehicle ahead with the "Aggressive" profile. Increase for larger gaps and more cautious following; decrease for tighter gaps and closer following.

params.label: Slowdown Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot slows down with the "Aggressive" profile. Increase for more gradual deceleration; decrease for faster but sharper slowdowns.

params.label: Speed-Up Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot speeds up with the "Aggressive" profile. Increase for more gradual acceleration; decrease for quicker but more jolting acceleration.

params.label: Following Distance
params.description:
How many seconds openpilot follows behind lead vehicles when using the "Standard" profile. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

Default: 1.45 seconds.

params.label: High Speed Following Distance
params.description: Following distance for higher speeds in the "Standard" profile. openpilot smoothly blends from the base value to this value as speed rises.

params.label: Acceleration Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot accelerates with the "Standard" profile. Increase for gentler starts; decrease for faster but more abrupt takeoffs.

params.label: Braking Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot brakes with the "Standard" profile. Increase for gentler stops; decrease for quicker but sharper braking.

params.label: Safety Gap Bias
params.description: How much extra space openpilot keeps from the vehicle ahead with the "Standard" profile. Increase for larger gaps and more cautious following; decrease for tighter gaps and closer following.

params.label: Slowdown Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot slows down with the "Standard" profile. Increase for more gradual deceleration; decrease for faster but sharper slowdowns.

params.label: Speed-Up Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot speeds up with the "Standard" profile. Increase for more gradual acceleration; decrease for quicker but more jolting acceleration.

params.label: Following Distance
params.description:
How many seconds openpilot follows behind lead vehicles when using the "Relaxed" profile. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

Default: 1.6 seconds.

params.label: High Speed Following Distance
params.description: Following distance for higher speeds in the "Relaxed" profile. openpilot smoothly blends from the base value to this value as speed rises.

params.label: Acceleration Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot accelerates with the "Relaxed" profile. Increase for gentler starts; decrease for faster but more abrupt takeoffs.

params.label: Braking Smoothness
params.description: How smoothly openpilot brakes with the "Relaxed" profile. Increase for gentler stops; decrease for quicker but sharper braking.

params.label: Safety Gap Bias
params.description: How much extra space openpilot keeps from the vehicle ahead with the "Relaxed" profile. Increase for larger gaps and more cautious following; decrease for tighter gaps and closer following.

params.label: Slowdown Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot slows down with the "Relaxed" profile. Increase for more gradual deceleration; decrease for faster but sharper slowdowns.

params.label: Speed-Up Response
params.description: How smoothly openpilot speeds up with the "Relaxed" profile. Increase for more gradual acceleration; decrease for quicker but more jolting acceleration.

params.label: Longitudinal Tuning
params.description: Acceleration and braking control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.

params.label: Acceleration Profile
params.description: How quickly openpilot speeds up. "Eco" is gentle and efficient, "Sport" is firmer and more responsive, and "Sport+" accelerates at the maximum rate allowed.

params.label: Deceleration Profile
params.description: How firmly openpilot slows down. "Eco" favors coasting, "Sport" applies stronger braking.

params.label: Human-Like Lane Changes
params.description: Lane-change behavior that mimics human drivers by anticipating and tracking adjacent vehicles during lane changes.

params.label: Lead Detection Sensitivity
params.description: How sensitive openpilot is to detecting vehicles. Higher sensitivity allows quicker detection at longer distances but may react to non-vehicle objects; lower sensitivity is more conservative and reduces false detections.

params.label: \"Taco Bell Run\" Turn Speed Hack
params.description: The turn-speed hack from comma's 2022 "Taco Bell Run". Designed to slow down for left and right turns.

params.label: Use Route Speed Control
params.description: Allow an active navigation route to reduce cruise speed for upcoming turns, ramps, and roundabouts.

params.label: Quality of Life
params.description: Miscellaneous acceleration and braking control changes to fine-tune how openpilot drives.

params.label: Cruise Interval
params.description: How much the set speed increases or decreases for each + or – cruise control button press.

params.label: Cruise Interval (Hold)
params.description: How much the set speed increases or decreases while holding the + or – cruise control buttons.

params.label: Force Stop at \"Detected\" Stop Lights/Signs
params.description:
Force openpilot to stop whenever the driving model "detects" a red light or stop sign.

Disclaimer: openpilot does not explicitly detect traffic lights or stop signs. In "Experimental Mode", openpilot makes end-to-end driving decisions from camera input, which means it may stop even when there's no clear reason!

params.label: Force Stop Distance Offset
params.description: Tune where Force Stops bring the car to rest. Positive values let the car roll further before stopping (longer stop, closer to the line). Negative values stop the car sooner (more buffer before the line).

params.label: Force Standstill State
params.description:
Keep openpilot in the standstill state until you press the gas pedal or the Resume/+ cruise button.

This applies to any engaged stop, not just red lights or stop signs.

params.label: Radar for Takeoffs
params.description: Turns on/off using radar data to track leads at standstill, making following/takeoffs more responsive once leads move.

params.label: Increase Stopped Distance by:
params.description: Add extra space when stopped behind vehicles. Increase for more room; decrease for shorter gaps.

params.label: Map Accel/Decel to Gears
params.description: Map the Acceleration or Deceleration profiles to the vehicle's "Eco" and "Sport" gear modes.

params.label: Offset Set Speed by:
params.description: Increase the set speed by the chosen offset. For example, set +5 if you usually drive 5 over the limit.

params.label: Pulse and Glide Speed Delta
params.description: Developer-only: when Pulse and Glide is assigned to a wheel button, coast this far below the current cruise target before accelerating back up.

params.label: Weather Condition Offsets
params.description: Automatically adjust driving behavior based on real-time weather. Helps maintain comfort and safety in low visibility, rain, or snow.

params.label: Low Visibility (fog)
params.description: Customise settings for driving in low visibility situations

params.label: Increase Following Distance by:
params.description: Add extra space behind lead vehicles in low visibility. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

params.label: Increase Stopped Distance by:
params.description: Add extra buffer when stopped behind vehicles in low visibility. Increase for more room; decrease for shorter gaps.

params.label: Reduce Acceleration by:
params.description: Lower the maximum acceleration in low visibility. Increase for softer takeoffs; decrease for quicker but less stable takeoffs.

params.label: Reduce Speed in Curves by:
params.description: Lower the desired speed while driving through curves in low visibility. Increase for safer, gentler turns; decrease for more aggressive driving in curves.

params.label: Light/Medium Rain
params.description: Customise settings for driving in light & medium rain

params.label: Increase Following Distance by:
params.description: Add extra space behind lead vehicles in rain. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

params.label: Increase Stopped Distance by:
params.description: Add extra buffer when stopped behind vehicles in rain. Increase for more room; decrease for shorter gaps.

params.label: Reduce Acceleration by:
params.description: Lower the maximum acceleration in rain. Increase for softer takeoffs; decrease for quicker but less stable takeoffs.

params.label: Reduce Speed in Curves by:
params.description: Lower the desired speed while driving through curves in rain. Increase for safer, gentler turns; decrease for more aggressive driving in curves.

params.label: Heavy Rain
params.description: Customise settings for driving in heavy rain

params.label: Increase Following Distance by:
params.description: Add extra space behind lead vehicles in a rainstorm. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

params.label: Increase Stopped Distance by:
params.description: Add extra buffer when stopped behind vehicles in a rainstorm. Increase for more room; decrease for shorter gaps.

params.label: Reduce Acceleration by:
params.description: Lower the maximum acceleration in a rainstorm. Increase for softer takeoffs; decrease for quicker but less stable takeoffs.

params.label: Reduce Speed in Curves by:
params.description: Lower the desired speed while driving through curves in a rainstorm. Increase for safer, gentler turns; decrease for more aggressive driving in curves.

params.label: Snow
params.description: Customise settings for driving in snow

params.label: Increase Following Distance by:
params.description: Add extra space behind lead vehicles in snow. Increase for more space; decrease for tighter gaps.

params.label: Increase Stopped Distance by:
params.description: Add extra buffer when stopped behind vehicles in snow. Increase for more room; decrease for shorter gaps.

params.label: Reduce Acceleration by:
params.description: Lower the maximum acceleration in snow. Increase for softer takeoffs; decrease for quicker but less stable takeoffs.

params.label: Reduce Speed in Curves by:
params.description: Lower the desired speed while driving through curves in snow. Increase for safer, gentler turns; decrease for more aggressive driving in curves.

params.label: Speed Limit Controller
params.description: Limit openpilot's maximum driving speed to the current speed limit from configured map, dashboard, and optional vision sources.

params.label: Confirm New Speed Limits
params.description: Ask before changing to a new speed limit. To accept, tap the flashing on-screen widget or press the Cruise Increase button. To deny, press the Cruise Decrease button or ignore the prompt for 30 seconds.

params.label: Confirm Lower Limits
params.description: Require confirmation before applying a newly detected lower speed limit.

params.label: Confirm Higher Limits
params.description: Require confirmation before applying a newly detected higher speed limit.

params.label: Higher Limit Lookahead Time
params.description: How far ahead openpilot anticipates upcoming higher speed limits from downloaded map data.

params.label: Lower Limit Lookahead Time
params.description: How far ahead openpilot anticipates upcoming lower speed limits from downloaded map data.

params.label: Match Speed Limit on Engage
params.description: When openpilot is first enabled, automatically set the max speed to the current posted limit.

params.label: Fallback Speed
params.description: Choose the speed to use when no speed limit source is currently available.

params.label: Override Speed
params.description: Choose how SLC behaves after you manually drive faster than the posted speed limit.

params.label: Use Mapbox as Fallback
params.description: Use Mapbox speed-limit data when no other source is available.

params.label: Primary Speed Limit Source
params.description: Choose the first speed-limit source to trust when more than one is available.

params.label: Secondary Speed Limit Source
params.description: Choose the backup speed-limit source when the primary one is unavailable.

params.label: Speed Offset (0–24 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 0 and 24 mph.

params.label: Speed Offset (25–34 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 25 and 34 mph.

params.label: Speed Offset (35–44 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 35 and 44 mph.

params.label: Speed Offset (45–54 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 45 and 54 mph.

params.label: Speed Offset (55–64 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 55 and 64 mph.

params.label: Speed Offset (65–74 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 65 and 74 mph.

params.label: Speed Offset (75–99 mph)
params.description: How much to offset posted speed-limits between 75 and 99 mph.

params.label: Show Speed Limit Offset
params.description: Show the current offset from the posted limit on the driving screen.

params.label: Show Speed Limit Sources
params.description: Display the speed-limit sources and their current values on the driving screen.

params.label: Conditional Chill Mode
params.description: Keep "Experimental Mode" on by default, but temporarily switch to "Chill Mode" in simple cruising scenes where speed holding is usually better.

params.label: Persist Chill State
params.description: Keep your manual Conditional Chill override through reboots until you manually clear it.

params.label: Above
params.description: Switch to "Chill Mode" on open roads above this speed when no lead is detected and the car is still below the set speed.

params.label: Above (With Lead)
params.description: Switch to "Chill Mode" when following a stable lead above this speed.

params.label: Stable Lead Ahead
params.description: Switch to "Chill Mode" when following a steady, well-tracked lead vehicle at cruising speeds.

params.label: Launch Assist
params.description: Temporarily switch to "Chill Mode" when starting from a stop if planner is already allowing throttle. Useful if your car launches too slowly from lights or stop signs.

params.label: Set Speed Margin
params.description: How far below the set speed the car must be before open-road Conditional Chill can engage.

params.label: Status Widget
params.description: Show which condition triggered "Chill Mode" on the driving screen.

params.label: Show Abbreviated Icon Sources
params.description: Render the speed-limit sources as compact text labels (e.g. "Dash-45", "MapD-30") without icons.

params.label: Only Show Sources With Speed Limits
params.description: Hide source rows that have no current speed limit reading. Works with both abbreviated and full display.

params.label: Vision Speed Limit Detection
params.description: Use the road camera to detect and display speed-limit signs, with optional use by Speed Limit Controller.

params.label: Ignore Low Vision Speed Limits
params.description: When SLC is enabled, prevent it from acting on vision-detected speed limits at or below the configured threshold. Detection, display, debugging, and training collection remain active.

params.label: Ignore At or Below
params.description: Vision-detected limits at or below this value will not control speed. The value uses your selected mph or km/h unit.

params.label: Auto-Bookmark Vision Signs
params.description: Automatically save confirmed vision-detected speed limit signs into the speed-limit debug session so they can be imported into the training set later.

params.label: Collect Extra Vision Training Samples
params.description: Save lower-threshold vision sign candidates into the debug session for later training import without showing or applying them live. Leave this on if you want to help improve the model.

params.label: Preserve Auto-Bookmarked Segments
params.description: Also send a real bookmark for confirmed auto-bookmarks so loggerd preserves the route segment. Leave this off unless you specifically want the extra storage usage.

params.label: Advanced UI Controls
params.description: Advanced visual changes to fine-tune how the driving screen looks.

params.label: Hide Current Speed
params.description: Hide the current speed from the driving screen.

params.label: Lead Indicator
params.description: Show the lead-vehicle marker on the driving screen.

params.label: Hide Max Speed
params.description: Hide the max speed from the driving screen.

params.label: Hide Non-Critical Alerts
params.description: Hide non-critical alerts from the driving screen.

params.label: Hide Steering Wheel
params.description: Hide the steering-wheel button from the top-right of the driving screen.

params.label: Use Wheel Speed
params.description: Use the vehicle's wheel speed instead of the cluster speed. This is purely a visual change and doesn't impact how openpilot drives!

params.label: Holiday Themes
params.description: Automatically apply seasonal theme assets during holiday windows. Turn this off to keep your normal theme year-round.

params.label: Driving Screen Widgets
params.description: Custom StarPilot widgets for the driving screen.

params.label: Acceleration Path
params.description: Color the driving path by planned acceleration and braking.

params.label: Rainbow Road
params.description:
Color the driving path like a rainbow road.

On the Python UIs this overrides acceleration and braking path coloring.

params.label: Show Mode Status Banner
params.description: Show a popup banner when the Python driving UIs switch into chill, experimental, switchback, or override mode.

params.label: Adjacent Lanes
params.description: Show the driving paths for the left and right lanes.

params.label: Blind Spot Path
params.description: Show a red path when a vehicle is in that lane's blind spot.

params.label: Enable PiP Side Preview
params.description: Show a temporary Picture-in-Picture bubble of the side window while the turn signal is on or a blind spot is detected.
params.disabled_reason: Configure the PiP window mask first in Galaxy > PiP Side Camera

params.label: Show on Turn Signal
params.description: Display the side preview bubble while the corresponding turn signal is engaged.

params.label: Show on Blind Spot Detection
params.description: Display the side preview bubble when a vehicle is detected in the blind spot, whether from factory BSM, V-ASM, or both.

params.label: Compass
params.description: Show the current driving direction with a simple on-screen compass.

params.label: Driving Personality Button
params.description: Control and view the current driving personality via a driving screen widget.

params.label: Gas / Brake Pedal Indicators
params.description:
On-screen gas and brake indicators.

Dynamic: Opacity changes according to how much openpilot is accelerating or braking
Static: Full when active, dim when not

params.label: Dynamic
params.description: Fade the gas and brake indicators based on how much openpilot is accelerating or braking.

params.label: Static
params.description: Show full-strength gas and brake indicators when active, and dim them when inactive.

params.label: Rotating Steering Wheel
params.description: Rotate the driving screen wheel with the physical steering wheel.

params.label: Model UI
params.description: Model visualizations for the driving path, lane lines, path edges, and road edges.

params.label: Dynamic Path Width
params.description:
Change the path width based on engagement.

Fully Engaged: 100%
Always On Lateral: 75%
Disengaged: 50%

params.label: Lane Lines Width
params.description:
Set the lane-line thickness.

Default matches the MUTCD lane-line width standard of 4 inches.

params.label: Lane Line Color
params.description:
Set a custom lane-line color for the Python UIs.

Use Stock to follow the default line color behavior.

params.label: Border Width
params.description:
Scale the driving-screen border thickness.

100% matches the stock border width.

params.label: Path Edges Width
params.description:
Set the driving-path edge width that represents different driving modes and statuses.

Default is 20% of the total path width.

Color Guide:

- Light Blue: Always On Lateral
- Green: Default
- Orange: Experimental Mode
- Red: Traffic Mode
- Yellow: Conditional Experimental Mode overridden

params.label: Path Edge Color
params.description:
Set a custom path-edge color for the Python UIs.

Use Stock to follow the default line color behavior.

params.label: Path Width
params.description:
Set the driving-path width.

Default (6.1 feet) matches the width of a 2019 Lexus ES 350.

params.label: Path Color
params.description:
Set a custom filled-path color for the Python UIs.

Use Stock to follow the default path color behavior.

params.label: Road Edges Width
params.description:
Set the road-edge thickness.

Default matches half of the MUTCD lane-line width standard of 4 inches.

params.label: Navigation Widgets
params.description: Speed limits, and other navigation widgets.

params.label: Clear Route When Offroad
params.description: Clear the active navigation destination when the device goes offroad.

params.label: Clear Route Delay
params.description: How long the device can stay offroad before clearing the active route. Set to 0 for immediate clearing.

params.label: Road Name
params.description: Display the road name at the bottom of the driving screen using data from "OpenStreetMap (OSM)".

params.label: Show Speed Limits
params.description: Show the current speed limit on the driving screen. The position depends on the device UI. Uses data from the car's dashboard (if supported) and "OpenStreetMap (OSM)".

params.label: Show Speed Limits from Mapbox
params.description: Use Mapbox speed-limit data when no other source is available.

params.label: Use Vienna-Style Speed Signs
params.description: Show Vienna-style (EU) speed-limit signs instead of MUTCD (US).

params.label: Quality of Life
params.description: Miscellaneous visual changes to fine-tune how the driving screen looks.

params.label: Camera View
params.description: Choose which camera feed the driving screen uses: Auto, Driver, Standard, or Wide.

params.label: Show Driver Camera When In Reverse
params.description: Show the driver camera feed when the vehicle is in reverse.

params.label: Stopped Timer
params.description: Show a timer when stopped in place of the current speed to indicate how long the vehicle has been stopped.

params.label: Stock Confidence Ball Widget
params.description: Use the original moving confidence ball on the small comma 4 UI instead of the fixed confidence, CEM/CCM, and personality sidebar.

params.label: Simple Mode
params.description: Use a more stock-like presentation by hiding most branch-specific UI, theme, sound, and alert styling. This only changes presentation and does not change driving behavior.

params.label: Hide Changing Lanes Banner
params.description: Hide the 'Changing Lanes' banner from the driving screen.

params.label: Hide Distance Profile Banner
params.description: Hide the driving personality banner when changing distance profiles.

params.label: Hide Driver Monitoring Icon
params.description: Hide the driver monitoring icon from the driving screen.

params.label: Hide Turning Banner
params.description: Hide the 'Turning Left/Right' banner from the driving screen.

params.label: Disable Wide Road Camera
params.description:
Only enable this if the wide camera is broken or for development!

Disabling the wide camera may degrade driving performance and cause instability.

Requires a reboot to take effect.

params.label: Alert Volume Controller
params.description: Set how loud each type of openpilot alert is to keep routine prompts from becoming distracting.

params.label: Switchback Mode Cooldown
params.description: Set the minimum time between repeated steering-limit and minimum-steer-speed alerts while "Switchback Mode" is active. Useful on winding roads where "Turn Exceeds Steering Limit" and "Steer Unavailable Under" can repeat frequently. Set to Off to disable the cooldown even when the mode is on.

params.label: Min Steer Speed Alert Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for the "Steer Unavailable Under" alert shown below the car's minimum steering speed.

Set to Muted to silence only this alert.

params.label: Disengage Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for alerts when openpilot disengages.

Examples include: "Cruise Fault: Restart the Car", "Parking Brake Engaged", "Pedal Pressed".

params.label: Engage Volume
params.description: Set the volume for the chime when openpilot engages, such as after pressing the "RESUME" or "SET" steering wheel buttons.

params.label: Prompt Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for prompts that need attention.

Examples include: "Car Detected in Blindspot", "Steering Temporarily Unavailable", "Turn Exceeds Steering Limit".

params.label: Prompt Distracted Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for prompts when openpilot detects driver distraction or unresponsiveness.

Examples include: "Pay Attention", "Touch Steering Wheel".

params.label: Refuse Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for alerts when openpilot refuses to engage.

Examples include: "Brake Hold Active", "Door Open", "Seatbelt Unlatched".

params.label: Warning Soft Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for softer warnings about potential risks.

Examples include: "BRAKE! Risk of Collision", "Steering Temporarily Unavailable".

params.label: Warning Immediate Volume
params.description:
Set the volume for the loudest warnings that require urgent attention.

Examples include: "DISENGAGE IMMEDIATELY — Driver Distracted", "DISENGAGE IMMEDIATELY — Driver Unresponsive".

params.label: Goat Scream
params.description: Play the infamous "Goat Scream" when the steering controller reaches its limit. Based on the "Turn Exceeds Steering Limit" event.

params.label: Goat Scream Critical Alerts
params.description:
Play the infamous "Goat Scream" for full-screen critical alerts that require immediate takeover.

Examples include: "TAKE CONTROL IMMEDIATELY" and "Stock AEB: Risk of Collision".

params.label: Green Light Alert
params.description:
Play an alert when the model predicts a red light has turned green.

Disclaimer: openpilot does not explicitly detect traffic lights. This alert is based on end-to-end model predictions from camera input and may trigger even when the light has not changed.

params.label: Lead Departing Alert
params.description: Play an alert when the lead vehicle departs from a stop.

params.label: Loud \"Car Detected in Blindspot\" Alert
params.description: Play a louder alert if a vehicle is in the blind spot when attempting to change lanes. Based on the "Car Detected in Blindspot" event.

params.label: Blind Spot Alert When Disengaged
params.description: Play the loud blind spot alert while lateral control is off or paused. Useful when steering pauses on turn signal, since the lane-change state machine is inactive then.

params.label: Speed Limit Changed Alert
params.description: Play an alert when the posted speed limit changes.

params.label: Car Make
params.description: Select your car make.

params.label: Car Model (Fingerprint)
params.description: Choose the fingerprint platform to use when automatic detection is disabled.

params.label: Rivian Angle Steering
params.description: Use the Extreme harness angle channel with cooperative torque fallback.

params.label: Disable Automatic Fingerprint Detection
params.description: Force the selected fingerprint and prevent it from changing automatically.

params.label: Right Hand Driving
params.description: Use right-hand-drive driver monitoring. This follows the auto-detected side until changed manually.

params.label: Disable openpilot Longitudinal
params.description: Use the vehicle's stock longitudinal control instead of openpilot longitudinal control. This can stop openpilot from sending cruise-control acceleration and braking commands on supported vehicles.

params.label: Tesla Model 3 Cooperative Steering
params.description: For Tesla Model 3 only. Converts light driver steering input into bounded steering-wheel rotation while lateral control remains active. Change while parked.

params.label: Tesla Pre-AP Bosch Radar
params.description: Use the stock Bosch radar path on pre-Autopilot Teslas.

params.label: Radar Behind Nosecone
params.description: Enable this if the Bosch radar is mounted behind the nosecone instead of being exposed.

params.label: Radar Offset
params.description: Adjust the radar position offset in meters if the radar alignment needs a small correction.

params.label: Tesla Pre-AP comma Pedal Longitudinal
params.description: Use a comma pedal interceptor for acceleration and regenerative braking on pre-Autopilot Teslas.

params.label: Pedal CAN Bus
params.description: Select the CAN bus used by the Tesla pedal interceptor.

params.label: Adaptive Acceleration Limit
params.description: Reduce maximum acceleration as you close in on a lead vehicle when Tesla pedal-long is active.

params.label: Pedal Calibration Complete
params.description: Enable only after entering valid Tesla pedal calibration values. Pedal-long stays inactive until this is on.

params.label: Pedal Calibration Factor
params.description: Scaling factor used to convert Tesla pedal interceptor output into the internal DI range.

params.label: Pedal Calibration Zero
params.description: Zero point used to convert Tesla pedal interceptor output into the internal DI range.

params.label: Use Pedal For Longitudinal
params.description: Use the pedal interceptor for full longitudinal control on supported GM vehicles.

params.label: Apply Offsets To Dash Spoof
params.description: On GM pedal-long cars, add the configured set-speed offset to the spoofed dash set speed so it matches the on-screen set speed.

params.label: Use CAN Ignition Only
params.description:
Use Panda firmware that ignores the physical ignition line and starts from CAN ignition only.

Requires a Panda flash. Use this only on vehicles with reliable CAN ignition when the harness box reports false ignition.

params.label: Smooth Pedal Response on Hills
params.description: Smoothen acceleration and braking when driving downhill/uphill.

params.label: Remote Start Boots Comma (GM)
params.description:
Use the remote-start GM panda firmware at boot.

Required for GM remote-start startup signal behavior.

params.label: Remote Start Boots Comma (HKG)
params.description:
Use the remote-climate Hyundai/Kia/Genesis CAN-FD panda firmware at boot.

Required for EV remote-climate startup signal behavior.

params.label: Stop-and-Go Hack
params.description: Force stop-and-go on the 2017 Chevy Volt.

params.label: Volt Auto Hold
params.description: Hold the car at a stop on supported non-CC-only Chevy Volts until the gas pedal is pressed.

params.label: Volt One Pedal Mode
params.description: On supported Chevy Volts in L / single-pedal mode, blend friction braking so the car can slow to a stop and hold without using the brake pedal.

params.label: Jeep Brake Hold
params.description: Hold the brakes after Jeep ACC times out at a stop, then send resume when traffic moves again.

params.label: Stop and Go
params.description: Stop and go for supported Subaru vehicles.

params.label: Stop and Go for Manual Parking Brake
params.description: Use the manual-parking-brake Subaru stop-and-go strategy. Enable this for supported Subaru Global models with a manual handbrake. Keep it off on models with an electric parking brake.

params.label: Dashboard Speed Offset
params.description: The speed offset openpilot uses to match the speed on the dashboard display.

params.label: Stop-and-Go Hack
params.description: Force stop-and-go on Lexus/Toyota vehicles without stock stop-and-go functionality.

params.label: Toyota Auto Hold
params.description: Hold the brakes at a stop on supported Toyota/Lexus TSS2 vehicles when cruise main is available and cruise is not active.

params.label: Remap Cancel Button
params.description: On pedal-interceptor Bolts, treat the steering-wheel CANCEL button as an extra mappable button.

params.label: Remap Cancel Button
params.description: On pedal-interceptor Bolts, treat the steering-wheel CANCEL button as an extra mappable button.

params.label: Nostalgia Mode
params.description: Use the left paddle to pause openpilot acceleration and braking while Always On Lateral stays active on supported Hyundai CAN-FD cars.

params.label: Cancel Button (Short Press)
params.description: Action performed when the remapped "Cancel" button is pressed.

params.label: Distance Button (Short Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Distance" button is pressed.

params.label: Cancel Button (Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the remapped "Cancel" button is pressed for more than 0.5 seconds.

params.label: Distance Button (Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Distance" button is pressed for more than 0.5 seconds.

params.label: Cancel Button (Extra Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the remapped "Cancel" button is pressed for more than 2.5 seconds.

params.label: Distance Button (Extra Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Distance" button is pressed for more than 2.5 seconds.

params.label: LKAS Button
params.description: Action performed when the "LKAS" button is pressed.

params.label: CC Main Button
params.description: Action performed when the cruise control main button is pressed.

params.label: Mode Button (Short Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Mode" button is pressed. Hyundai CAN-FD only.

params.label: Mode Button (Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Mode" button is pressed for more than 0.5 seconds. Hyundai CAN-FD only.

params.label: Mode Button (Extra Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Mode" button is pressed for more than 2.5 seconds. Hyundai CAN-FD only.

params.label: Star Button (Short Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Star" button is pressed. Hyundai CAN-FD only.

params.label: Star Button (Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Star" button is pressed for more than 0.5 seconds. Hyundai CAN-FD only.

params.label: Star Button (Extra Long Press)
params.description: Action performed when the "Star" button is pressed for more than 2.5 seconds. Hyundai CAN-FD only.

params.label: Device Settings
params.description: Settings that control how the device runs, powers off, and manages driving data.

params.label: Device Shutdown Timer (Hours)
params.description: How many hours the device stays on after a drive before it shuts down automatically.

params.label: Disable Logging
params.description:
WARNING: This will prevent your drives from being recorded and all data will be unobtainable!

Prevent the device from saving driving data.

params.label: Disable Uploads
params.description:
WARNING: This will prevent your drives from being uploaded to comma connect which will impact debugging and official support from comma!

Prevent the device from uploading driving data.

params.label: Disable Onroad Uploads
params.description: When "Disable Uploads" is enabled, allow uploads only while parked (offroad).

params.label: Always Allow Uploads
params.description: Override upload blocks and always keep uploader enabled. Advanced use only.

params.label: High-Quality Recording
params.description: Save drive footage in higher video quality.

params.label: Cellular Metered
params.description: Prevent large uploads on cellular. Turn this off to allow full/unfiltered uploads over mobile data.

params.label: Low-Voltage Cutoff
params.description: While parked, if the battery voltage falls below the set level, the device shuts down to prevent excessive battery drain.

params.label: Raise Temperature Limits
params.description:
WARNING: Running at higher temperatures may damage your device!

Allow the device to run at higher temperatures before throttling or shutting down. Use only if you understand the risks!

params.label: Use Konik Server
params.description: Upload driving data to "stable.konik.ai" instead of "connect.comma.ai".

params.label: Screen Settings
params.description: Settings that control screen brightness, screen recording, and timeout duration.

params.label: Screen Brightness (Offroad)
params.description: The screen brightness while not driving.

params.label: Screen Brightness (Onroad)
params.description: The screen brightness while driving.

params.label: Screen Recorder
params.description: Add a button to the driving screen to record the display.

params.label: Screen Timeout (Offroad)
params.description: How long the screen stays on after being tapped while not driving.

params.label: Screen Timeout (Onroad)
params.description: How long the screen stays on after being tapped while driving.

params.label: Standby Mode
params.description: Turn the screen off while driving and automatically wake it up for alerts or engagement state changes.

params.label: Developer UI
params.description: Detailed information about openpilot's internal operations.

params.label: Model Lateral Smoothing (s)
params.description: Developer-only model lateral action smoothing. Default is 0.10 seconds.

params.label: Model Longitudinal Smoothing (s)
params.description: Developer-only model longitudinal action smoothing. Default is 0.30 seconds.

params.label: Developer Metrics
params.description: Performance data, sensor readings, and system metrics for debugging and optimizing openpilot.

params.label: FPS Display
params.description: Show the frames per second at the bottom of the driving screen.

params.label: CPU Metrics
params.description: Show CPU usage in the driving screen developer metrics.

params.label: GPU Metrics
params.description: Show GPU usage in the driving screen developer metrics.

params.label: Temperature Metrics
params.description: Show numerical device temperature in the driving screen developer metrics.

params.label: RAM Metrics
params.description: Show memory usage in the driving screen developer metrics.

params.label: Enable Developer Mode
params.description: Show advanced settings in Galaxy.

params.label: openpilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)
params.description: Enable openpilot longitudinal control for vehicles that support it. This replaces the vehicle's stock ACC and may disable automatic emergency braking. Changing this setting restarts the driving stack.
params.confirm_message: Enable openpilot Longitudinal Control? This is an alpha feature, replaces the vehicle's stock ACC, and may disable automatic emergency braking.

params.label: Force Offroad
params.description: Temporarily switch the device to the offroad state for remote updates when the vehicle is parked. This control is only available while the vehicle reports Park.
params.confirm_message: Force the device offroad? Only use this while the vehicle is in Park.

params.label: Redneck Cruise
params.description: On supported Hyundai stock-cruise cars, use RES/SET button presses to match the cluster set speed to StarPilot's target.

params.label: Camera Offset
params.description: Virtually shift the camera perspective used by the driving model. Positive values bias the model center left; negative values bias it right. Use only for development.

params.label: Lane Centering
params.description: Experimentally bias the model command toward the detected lane center. Requires two confident lane lines and remains subject to normal curvature and jerk limits.

params.label: Lane Center Offset
params.description: Shift the lane target left or right in meters. The controller reduces this offset automatically when the detected lane is narrow.

params.label: Pause Lane Centering On Turn Signal
params.description: Fade lane-centering correction out when a turn signal is active so it does not fight a lane change or turn.

params.label: E2E Override Strength
params.description: Choose how strongly the vision model may override lane centering when it sees a hazard.

description_steps.description: Vehicle rigidly tries to center itself rather than avoiding hazards, potholes, or road debris.
Vehicle tries to center itself and slowly adjusts away from hazards, but may react too slowly.
Vehicle provides additional space around hazards like cyclists and vehicles crossing into the lane.
Vehicle smooths out hazard avoidance, making less rapid adjustments.
Vehicle reacts to hazards recognized by the vision model as quickly as possible.

params.label: Honda PID Kp Scale
params.description: Scale the active Honda lateralTuning.pid.kpV values from openDBC. Applies live to Honda PID lateral only.

params.label: Honda PID Ki Scale
params.description: Scale the active Honda lateralTuning.pid.kiV values from openDBC. Applies live to Honda PID lateral only.

params.label: Allow Impossible Acceleration
params.description:
WARNING: This suppresses openpilot's excessive longitudinal actuation diagnostic when measured acceleration looks impossible for the requested gas/brake command.

Leave this OFF unless you are intentionally testing edge cases like shifting to neutral and understand that it can hide a real actuation problem.
